documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management stated that Q1 FY27 is a strong start to the year with consolidated revenue growing 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increasing 35.2% to 43.2 crores, and PAT growing 44.9% to 33 crores. The company reported receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 of its Pune facility, providing a scalable manufacturing platform for cell connecting systems. Management expects overall revenue growth for the full year to be in the 20% to 30% range, with priorities centered on margin quality, working capital efficiency, cash conversion, and selective capital allocation. Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited reported a strong start to Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growth of 33.38% and PAT growth of 44.86% year-on-year. The company is focusing on forward integration into higher-value assemblies like PCBA and busbar connectors, supported by the new Pune facility.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth for FY27 to be between 20% and 30%.
guidance.quote: growth, you know, we… if things go as per what we have in, in forecast, etc, or what expectations we have from the customers, we could… we could, on an overall revenue basis be looking at somewhere… somewhere between the, you know, that 20% to 30% kind of a number.

guidance.claim: On a standalone basis, management expects approximately 44-45% of revenue from bimetals and 54-55% from shunts.
guidance.quote: we expect, like, maybe a 44-45% revenue coming from Bimetal, and 54-55% coming from shunts.

guidance.claim: On a consolidated level, the contacts business is expected to contribute around 30% to 35% of total revenue.
guidance.quote: On a consolidated level, I think we would be more like, maybe around, you know, like a 30-35% of total consolidated revenue would be from, somewhere between the 30% to 35% should be from the contacts business, which is the wholly owned subsidiary.

guidance.claim: Assemblies like PCB assemblies and bus bar assemblies are expected to contribute about 15-16% of total revenue in the first year.
guidance.quote: And, we expect that, from… from the… these assemblies, the PCB assemblies and these, bus bar assemblies, we expect, like, maybe a… about a… in the first year, maybe about a 15-16% of total revenue coming from that.

guidance.claim: The Pune facility's specific target product is projected to achieve a business potential of 300 to 400 crores in about 3 years' time.
guidance.quote: we expect the kind of business that we are looking at, or the value of that business that we can gain from this Pune facility for this particular thing, you know, somewhere in the range of 300 to 400 crores, and to in about 3 years' time

demand_outlook.claim: Shunts remained the stronger growth engine with revenue increasing 18.7%, while bimetals grew 7.4%.
demand_outlook.quote: From the quarter, Shunts remained the stronger growth engine, with revenue increasing 18.7%, but bimetals grew 7.4%.

demand_outlook.claim: India delivered broad-based growth across both businesses, and Europe grew strongly led by shunts.
demand_outlook.quote: India delivered broad-brace growth across both businesses. Europe grew strongly, led by shunts

demand_outlook.claim: The Americas showed early improvement in shunts with a 30% growth year-on-year in Q1 after a softer FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: the Americas also showing early improvement in shunts with a 30% growth year-on-year this quarter, after a softer FY26.

demand_outlook.claim: Asia was weaker during the quarter and remains an area focused on rebuilding momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Asia was weaker during the quarter, and remains an area where we are focused on building rebuild… on rebuilding momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in Asia remained soft during the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Asia remained softer and continues to be an area of management focus.

capex_expansion.claim: Receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 is an important milestone in the operationalization of the Pune facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Subsequent to the quarter, receiving consent to operate for Phase 1 is an important milestone in the operationalization of our Pune facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capital expenditure requirement for the entire cell connecting systems project is in the ballpark of 20 to 25 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the CAPEX requirement for this entire project is somewhere in the, you know, ballpark of about 20 to 25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is establishing a facility in Pune to enhance its capabilities in PCBA and busbar assemblies.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our growth strategy, we are establishing our Pune facility to strengthen our presence in PCBA and busbar assemblies for automotive and electrification-led applications.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2 to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to 182.2 crores, EBITDA increased 35.2 to 43.2 crores, and PAT grew 44.9% to 33 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%.
margins_costs.quote: Sequentially, revenue increased 13%, EBITDA 23%, and PAT 26%, giving us a strong operating start to FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased as the company invested in capacity, people, and capability.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, this margin improvement was achieved while employee costs increased as we invested in capacity, people, and capability, giving us confidence that the underlying operating model is strengthening as we scale.

margins_costs.claim: The company's existing asset base is capable of supporting over ₹1,300 crore in revenue.
margins_costs.quote: The existing asset base can support >₹ 1,300 Cr revenue, sustaining high incremental Pre-tax ROCE without major greenfield risk.

margins_costs.claim: In-house manufacturing of Electron Beam Welding machines provides a cost advantage compared to imports.
margins_costs.quote: Shivalik can build these specialised welding machines themselves for about half the cost of buying them from overseas.

orders_capacity.claim: Welding capacity utilization is currently at about 65% to 70%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, if we look at purely our welding capacity, right now we are at about 65%-70% of our welding capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates the largest Electron Beam Welding strip facility in Asia.
orders_capacity.quote: Operates Asia’s largest EBW strip facility and 77 proprietary bimetal grades; supplies 300+ OEM/Tier‑1 customers across 38 countries.

capital_allocation.claim: Management's priorities remain margin quality, working capital efficiency, cash conversion, and selective capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Our priorities remain margin quality, working capital efficiency, cash conversion, and selective capital allocation.

risks_headwinds.claim: As electrical contacts scale, precious metal content can affect reported revenue and gross margin, prompting a focus on EBITDA and cash generation.
risks_headwinds.quote: As electrical contact scale, precious metal content can affect reported revenue and gross margin, so we remain focused on EBITDA and cash generation.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve about 10-15% of the Pune facility's target revenue in year one.
management_commitments.quote: out of which we see maybe about 10-15% revenue coming in year 1.

management_commitments.claim: The Pune facility target revenue is expected to reach 150 to 200 crores in year two.
management_commitments.quote: Maybe about, you know, 150 to 200 crores in year two
